observations: Four photos show multiple black salon chairs with chrome bases and armrests.
The chairs have black upholstery, some showing wear and scuff marks.
The base is a circular chrome pedestal with a footrest, typical of salon chairs.
The armrests are chrome with black padding, and one chair has a cutout design on the side.
The chairs are in a cluttered outdoor or semi-outdoor space, likely a yard or workshop, with other chairs and materials in the background.
No brand or model is visible on any chair in any photo.
The seller claims 'Executive Salon chairs every part fully functional'.

claims.evidence: The chairs match the typical design of salon chairs with high backrests, armrests, and chrome bases.
No photo shows the chair in use or any part being operated. The base and seat appear intact, but functionality cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: The chair may not be fully functional (e.g., hydraulic lift, tilt, or recline mechanisms may be broken or non-operational).
risks.proof: A video clip showing the chair being raised, lowered, tilted, and reclined.

risks.risk: The upholstery may be damaged or worn beyond repair, especially in areas like the seat and backrest.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the seat, backrest, and armrests showing the condition of the black material.

risks.risk: The chrome base may be loose, cracked, or have rust, affecting stability and safety.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the base, especially the pedestal and footrest, showing any signs of corrosion or structural damage.

proof_requests: Video showing the chair being raised, lowered, tilted, and reclined.
Close-up photos of the seat, backrest, and armrests to assess upholstery condition.
Close-up photos of the chrome base to check for rust, cracks, or loose parts.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
